'};", "test": {"inputs": {"isn": "5", "va": 15, "rct": 0.4, "alf": 20, "vk": 150}, "expect": "100.0"}}, {"id": "dgsequence", "cat": "dgjs", "icon": "🔺", "name": "对称分量变换", "desc": "由三相电压幅值与相位算正序/负序/零序分量与电压不平衡度（复数运算）", "formula": "算子 a=1∠120°=−0.5+j0.866，a²=1∠240°。U₁=(Ua+a·Ub+a²·Uc)÷3，U₂=(Ua+a²·Ub+a·Uc)÷3，U₀=(Ua+Ub+Uc)÷3（复数实部/虚部分量计算，输出幅值∠相位）。不平衡度 ε=|U₂|÷|U₁|×100%（GB/T 15543 常用限值 2%、短时 4%）。完全对称时 U₂=U₀=0", "inputs": [{"id": "ua", "label": "A 相电压幅值", "unit": "V", "def": "220"}, {"id": "pa", "label": "A 相相位", "unit": "°", "def": "0"}, {"id": "ub", "label": "B 相电压幅值", "unit": "V", "def": "220"}, {"id": "pb", "label": "B 相相位", "unit": "°", "def": "-120"}, {"id": "uc", "label": "C 相电压幅值", "unit": "V", "def": "220"}, {"id": "pc", "label": "C 相相位", "unit": "°", "def": "120"}], "run": "var ms=[Number(ua),Number(ub),Number(uc)],ps=[Number(pa),Number(pb),Number(pc)];for(var i=0;i<3;i++){if(!(ms[i]>=0&&ms[i]<=1000000))return {ok:false,msg:'各相幅值须在 0~1000000 V'};if(!(ps[i]>=-360&&ps[i]<=360))return {ok:false,msg:'各相相位须在 −360~360°'};}if(ms[0]+ms[1]+ms[2]<=0)return {ok:false,msg:'三相幅值不能全为 0'};function pol(m,d){var r=d*Math.PI/180;return [m*Math.cos(r),m*Math.sin(r)];}function mul(x,y){return [x[0]*y[0]-x[1]*y[1],x[0]*y[1]+x[1]*y[0]];}function add3(x,y,z){return [(x[0]+y[0]+z[0])/3,(x[1]+y[1]+z[1])/3];}function fmt(z){var m=Math.sqrt(z[0]*z[0]+z[1]*z[1]);var d=Math.atan2(z[1],z[0])*180/Math.PI;return m.toFixed(2)+' V ∠ '+d.toFixed(1)+'°';}var A=pol(ms[0],ps[0]),B=pol(ms[1],ps[1]),C=pol(ms[2],ps[2]);var a=[-0.5,0.8660254],a2=[-0.5,-0.8660254];var u1=add3(A,mul(a,B),mul(a2,C));var u2=add3(A,mul(a2,B),mul(a,C));var u0=add3(A,B,C);var m1=Math.sqrt(u1[0]*u1[0]+u1[1]*u1[1]);var m2=Math.sqrt(u2[0]*u2[0]+u2[1]*u2[1]);if(!(m1>0))return {ok:false,msg:'正序分量为 0，无法计算不平衡度'};var eps=m2/m1*100;return {ok:true,html:'
正序 U₁ = '+fmt(u1)+'
负序 U₂ = '+fmt(u2)+'；零序 U₀ = '+fmt(u0)+'
不平衡度 ε = U₂/U₁ = '+eps.toFixed(2)+'%（常用限值 2%，短时 4%）
'};", "test": {"inputs": {"ua": 220, "pa": 0, "ub": 220, "pb": -120, "uc": 220, "pc": 120}, "expect": "220.00"}}, {"id": "dgpu", "cat": "dgjs", "icon": "🔄", "name": "标幺值换算", "desc": "有名值与标幺值互算，以及标幺值在两组基准容量/电压间的折算", "formula": "有名→标幺：X*=X÷X基准；标幺→有名：X=X*×X基准。基准变更：X*新=X*旧×(S新÷S旧)×(U旧÷U新)²（阻抗标幺口径，S 基准容量、U 基准电压须为同一电压等级）。各分支只用对应输入", "inputs": [{"id": "mode", "label": "换算分支", "type": "select", "def": "change", "options": [{"v": "name", "t": "有名值 → 标幺值"}, {"v": "pu", "t": "标幺值 → 有名值"}, {"v": "change", "t": "基准变更折算"}]}, {"id": "val", "label": "待换算值（有名值或标幺值）", "def": "0.2"}, {"id": "base", "label": "基准值（有名↔标幺分支）", "when": "mode=name", "def": "50"}, {"id": "base2", "label": "基准值（标幺→有名分支）", "when": "mode=pu", "def": "50"}, {"id": "sold", "label": "旧基准容量", "unit": "MVA", "when": "mode=change", "def": "100"}, {"id": "snew", "label": "新基准容量", "unit": "MVA", "when": "mode=change", "def": "50"}, {"id": "uold", "label": "旧基准电压", "unit": "kV", "when": "mode=change", "def": "110"}, {"id": "unew", "label": "新基准电压", "unit": "kV", "when": "mode=change", "def": "110"}], "run": "var v=Number(val);if(!(v>=0)||!isFinite(v))return {ok:false,msg:'待换算值须为非负数'};if(String(mode)==='name'){var b=Number(base);if(!(b>0))return {ok:false,msg:'基准值须大于 0'};var r1=v/b;return {ok:true,html:'

'};", "test": {"inputs": {"ds": 5, "ssc": 100, "lim": "2.5"}, "expect": "5.00"}}, {"id": "dgtouch", "cat": "dgjs", "icon": "🦶", "name": "接触与跨步电压估算", "desc": "接地网地电位升、接触/跨步电压简化估算与 IEEE 80 安全限值比较", "formula": "简化口径（IEEE 80 思路的工程近似，非替代正式设计）：等值圆盘电极 Rg≈ρ·√(π÷A)÷4（A 网面积 m²），地电位升 GPR=Ig·Rg。实际接触电压取 GPR×网孔系数 kt（本工具经验式 kt=min(0.35, 0.05+0.02·网孔边长m)），跨步电压取接触值的 0.6 倍。安全限值（50kg 体重、表层校正系数 Cs≈1 简化）：允许接触=(1000+1.5ρs)·0.116÷√ts，允许跨步=(1000+6ρs)·0.116÷√ts（ρs 表层电阻率，ts 持续时间 s）", "inputs": [{"id": "Ig", "label": "最大入地电流 Ig", "unit": "A", "def": "1000"}, {"id": "rho", "label": "土壤电阻率 ρ", "unit": "Ω·m", "def": "100"}, {"id": "rhos", "label": "表层电阻率 ρs", "unit": "Ω·m", "def": "3000", "hint": "碎石层常用约 3000"}, {"id": "area", "label": "接地网面积 A", "unit": "㎡", "def": "10000"}, {"id": "mesh", "label": "网孔边长", "unit": "m", "def": "5"}, {"id": "ts", "label": "故障持续时间 ts", "unit": "s", "def": "1"}], "run": "var ig=Number(Ig),rh=Number(rho),rs=Number(rhos),ar=Number(area),ms=Number(mesh),tt=Number(ts);if(!(ig>0&&ig<=1000000))return {ok:false,msg:'入地电流须大于 0'};if(!(rh>0))return {ok:false,msg:'土壤电阻率须大于 0'};if(!(rs>=0))return {ok:false,msg:'表层电阻率不能为负'};if(!(ar>0))return {ok:false,msg:'接地网面积须大于 0'};if(!(ms>0&&ms<=50))return {ok:false,msg:'网孔边长须在 0~50 m'};if(!(tt>=0.03&&tt<=3))return {ok:false,msg:'持续时间须在 0.03~3 s'};var rg=rh*Math.sqrt(Math.PI/ar)/4;var gpr=ig*rg;var kt=Math.min(0.35,0.05+0.02*ms);var et=gpr*kt,es=et*0.6;var at=(1000+1.5*rs)*0.116/Math.sqrt(tt);var as=(1000+6*rs)*0.116/Math.sqrt(tt);return {ok:true,html:'

安全限值：接触 '+at.toFixed(0)+' V、跨步 '+as.toFixed(0)+' V（ts '+tt+' s）：'+(et<=at&&es<=as?'估算值均在限值内':et>at?'接触电压超限，须加密网孔/加均压带/提高表层电阻率':'跨步电压超限，须优化网边缘布置')+'

'};", test:{inputs:{ft:1000,b:20,m:2,z:20,sa:120}, expect:"78.1"}}, {id:"djhertz", cat:"dj", icon:"🔘", name:"齿面接触应力", desc:"赫兹公式算齿面接触应力并与许用应力比较", formula:"σH = ZE·√[ Ft(u+1) ÷ (b·d1·u) ]（Ft 圆周力 N，b 齿宽 mm，d1 小齿轮分度圆直径 mm，u = z2/z1 传动比）；弹性系数 ZE 钢对钢 = 189.8 √MPa", inputs:[ {id:"ft", label:"圆周力 Ft", unit:"N", def:"1000"}, {id:"b", label:"齿宽 b", unit:"mm", def:"20"}, {id:"d1", label:"小齿轮分度圆 d1", unit:"mm", def:"40"}, {id:"u", label:"传动比 u", def:"3"}, {id:"sa", label:"许用接触应力 [σH]", unit:"MPa", def:"400"} ], run:"var Ft=Number(ft),B=Number(b),D=Number(d1),U=Number(u),SA=Number(sa);if(!(Ft>0))return {ok:false,msg:'圆周力须大于 0'};if(!(B>0))return {ok:false,msg:'齿宽须大于 0'};if(!(D>0))return {ok:false,msg:'分度圆直径须大于 0'};if(!(U>0))return {ok:false,msg:'传动比须大于 0'};if(!(SA>0))return {ok:false,msg:'许用应力须大于 0'};var sig=189.8*Math.sqrt(Ft*(U+1)/(B*D*U));var ok=sig<=SA;return {ok:true,html:'

'};", test:{inputs:{pd:7.5,z:3,v:10,alpha:180,q:"0.10"}, expect:"197.5"}}, {id:"djkey", cat:"dj", icon:"🔑", name:"键连接强度校核", desc:"按轴径选常用平键尺寸，校核挤压应力与剪切应力", formula:"键尺寸按 GB/T 1095 节选（轴径 d mm → 键宽×键高 b×h mm）：22~30→8×7、30~38→10×8、38~44→12×8、44~50→14×9、50~58→16×10，也可自填；挤压应力 σp = 4T ÷ (d·h·l)（T 转矩 N·mm，l 有效工作长度 mm；式中已计入工作面高度取 h/2）；剪切应力 τ = 2T ÷ (d·b·l)", inputs:[ {id:"mode", label:"键尺寸来源", type:"select", def:"t", options:[{v:"t",t:"按轴径查常用表"},{v:"c",t:"自填键宽×键高"}]}, {id:"d", label:"轴径 d", unit:"mm", def:"30"}, {id:"bc", label:"键宽 b（自填）", unit:"mm", when:"mode=c", def:"8"}, {id:"hc", label:"键高 h（自填）", unit:"mm", when:"mode=c", def:"7"}, {id:"tq", label:"传递转矩 T", unit:"N·m", def:"200"}, {id:"leff", label:"键有效工作长度 l", unit:"mm", def:"40"}, {id:"sap", label:"许用挤压应力 [σp]", unit:"MPa", def:"120"}, {id:"sat", label:"许用剪应力 [τ]", unit:"MPa", def:"60"} ], run:"var D=Number(d),T=Number(tq),L=Number(leff),SAP=Number(sap),SAT=Number(sat);if(!(D>0))return {ok:false,msg:'轴径须大于 0'};if(!(T>0))return {ok:false,msg:'转矩须大于 0'};if(!(L>0))return {ok:false,msg:'有效长度须大于 0'};if(!(SAP>0)||!(SAT>0))return {ok:false,msg:'许用应力须大于 0'};var b,h;if(String(mode)==='c'){b=Number(bc);h=Number(hc);if(!(b>0)||!(h>0))return {ok:false,msg:'自填键宽、键高须大于 0'};}else{if(D>=22&&D<=30){b=8;h=7;}else if(D>30&&D<=38){b=10;h=8;}else if(D>38&&D<=44){b=12;h=8;}else if(D>44&&D<=50){b=14;h=9;}else if(D>50&&D<=58){b=16;h=10;}else return {ok:false,msg:'轴径超出节选表 22~58 mm，请改用自填键尺寸'};}var Tm=T*1000;var sp=4*Tm/(D*h*L);var tau=2*Tm/(D*b*L);var ok=sp<=SAP&&tau<=SAT;return {ok:true,html:'
挤压应力 σp = '+sp.toFixed(2)+' MPa

'};", test:{inputs:{G:"6.3",m:20,n:3000}, expect:"20.05"}}, {id:"djpressfit", cat:"dj", icon:"🔩", name:"过盈配合压入力", desc:"厚壁筒公式算接触压强与压入力，并给装配加热温差提示", formula:"接触压强 p = δ ÷ { d×[ (1/E外)((D²+d²)/(D²−d²) − ν) + (1/E内)((d²+dᵢ²)/(d²−dᵢ²) + ν) ] }（厚壁筒 Lamé 式，δ/d 单位 mm，E 单位 MPa，内外件同材料）；压入力 F = p·π·d·L·μ；加热温差参考 ΔT ≈ δ ÷ (α·d)，α=12×10⁻⁶/K（钢）", inputs:[ {id:"delta", label:"过盈量 δ", unit:"μm", def:"50"}, {id:"d", label:"配合直径 d", unit:"mm", def:"50"}, {id:"L", label:"配合长度 L", unit:"mm", def:"40"}, {id:"Do", label:"外件外径 D", unit:"mm", def:"80"}, {id:"Di", label:"内件内径 dᵢ（实心轴填 0）", unit:"mm", def:"0"}, {id:"mat", label:"材料（内外件相同）", type:"select", def:"steel", options:[{v:"steel",t:"钢 E=210GPa ν=0.30"},{v:"ci",t:"铸铁 E=110GPa ν=0.25"},{v:"al",t:"铝合金 E=70GPa ν=0.33"},{v:"brass",t:"黄铜 E=100GPa ν=0.35"}]}, {id:"mu", label:"摩擦系数 μ", def:"0.1", hint:"压入钢-钢约 0.07~0.13，可改"} ], run:"var DL=Number(delta)/1000,DD=Number(d),LL=Number(L),DO=Number(Do),DI=Number(Di),MU=Number(mu);if(!(DL>0))return {ok:false,msg:'过盈量须大于 0'};if(!(DD>0))return {ok:false,msg:'配合直径须大于 0'};if(!(LL>0))return {ok:false,msg:'配合长度须大于 0'};if(!(DO>DD))return {ok:false,msg:'外件外径须大于配合直径'};if(!(DI>=0&&DI0&&MU<1))return {ok:false,msg:'摩擦系数须在 (0,1) 内'};var EM={steel:[210000,0.3],ci:[110000,0.25],al:[70000,0.33],brass:[100000,0.35]};var pr=EM[String(mat)]||EM.steel;var E=pr[0],nu=pr[1];var co=(DO*DO+DD*DD)/(DO*DO-DD*DD)-nu;var ci=(DD*DD+DI*DI)/(DD*DD-DI*DI)+nu;var p=DL/(DD*(co+ci)/E);var F=p*Math.PI*DD*LL*MU;var dT=DL/(12e-6*DD);return {ok:true,html:'
